title: Secret versioning & environment-grouped rollback
designSystem: Tailwind tokens (primary/secondary) mirrored in ds.js — tokens only, no raw hex/px in frame markup

frames.title: Environments
frames.acceptanceNotes: Grid of environment cards (Dev/Prod/Staging) with current snapshot version, secret count, snapshot count. 'New environment' primary action. Cards link to the environment detail.

frames.title: Environment detail (secrets table)
frames.acceptanceNotes: Secrets table: key, masked value, current version badge, updated. Values masked by default with a Reveal affordance. Header actions: History (snapshots), Export .env, Add secret. Rolled-back secrets show a 'rolled back' version badge.

frames.title: Secret history drawer (reveal + rollback)
frames.acceptanceNotes: Right drawer with the per-secret version timeline (current highlighted). Each version: author/time/comment, masked value with Reveal, 'Roll back to vN'. One version shown revealed to demonstrate the revealed state. Footer states rollback is append-only.

frames.title: Environment snapshot timeline + rollback-to-vN
frames.acceptanceNotes: Snapshot timeline (current highlighted) with 'Roll back to vN' per snapshot and a confirm panel showing the per-secret diff a rollback would apply, stating a new snapshot is appended. This is the 'rollback list Dev to v N' flow.

frames.title: Export .env
frames.acceptanceNotes: Modal exporting the current (or a chosen snapshot's) values as a .env. Masked by default; a 'Reveal values' checkbox (audited) expands them. Copy and Download actions. Empty environment disables export.
